title: Ask Entropy Reducer and Initial Scope Synthesizer
creator: Priya Shah
description: Create a lightweight ‘Ask Entropy Reducer’ — a systematic synthesis process and minimal template that converts raw Sales/CS inbound enterprise feature asks into a single canonical request with initial scoping. Goal: reduce duplicate asks, normalize language across reps, produce a 1-page scoping artifact with use case, success metrics, rough effort band, and recommended prioritization within 48 hours of intake. This ticket builds the template, the synthesis rubric, and a pilot plan with three large accounts.
background: Sales and Customer Success submit large-volume enterprise asks in inconsistent formats (emails, notes, Deal rooms). PMs and Eng spend cycles clarifying basic questions repeatedly (goal, primary persona, data residency constraints, desired SLOs). Existing intake playbooks focus on backlog-level triage; we need a faster canonicalization layer that can be executed by Sales Ops or CS leads before PM prioritization. This reduces duplicated work, surfaces common themes earlier, and speeds decision-making for Dedicated/Private conversations.
scope_inclusions: A 1-page canonical scoping template (Notion + JSON schema) that captures: summary, primary customer, business objective, success metrics, must-have constraints, workaround, rough effort band (T-shirt), and suggested priority.
A simple rubric for merging duplicate/overlapping asks (rules & matching heuristics).
A pilot workflow: Sales/CS -> Sales Ops review -> PM backlog entry with canonical artifact within 48h.
Documentation for Sales/CS on how to use the template and when to escalate to Enterprise PMs.
scope_exclusions: Full automation/ML classification of asks (out of scope for initial pilot).
Engineering estimations beyond a high-level T-shirt band and rough risk notes.
Changes to existing contract/legal templates or pricing models.
success_metrics: Median time from initial ask to canonical artifact <= 48 hours for pilot cohort.
Reduction in duplicate backlog items for pilot accounts by >= 40% over 6 weeks.
PMs report >= 30% less clarification messages for triaged asks in pilot period.
Sales/CS adoption: at least 80% of qualifying asks from pilot reps use the template.
proposed_solution: Design a minimal scoping canvas that Sales/CS can fill (or Sales Ops can synthesize). Create a short rubric for merging similar asks and a priority recommendation matrix (impact x feasibility). Host the template in Notion and provide a one-click exportable JSON to attach to the PM backlog entry. Train a small Sales Ops team to run synthesis during weekly intake windows. Iterate after a 6-week pilot and evaluate automation opportunities (NLP-assisted grouping) in a subsequent phase.
rollout_plan: Week 0-1: finalize template and rubric; record a 10-minute screencast for Sales reps. Week 2: run dry-run with Sales Ops on 6 recent asks and refine. Week 3-8: pilot with three enterprise accounts (selected by ARR and request volume) — Sales Ops synthesizes incoming asks; PMs accept/reject canonical items. End of week 8: Review metrics and decide next steps (scale, add automation, or retire).
risks_mitigation: Risk: Sales reps won't adopt the template -> Mitigation: short (10m) training + embed template link into the Deal room and weekly CS playbook.
Risk: Synthesized artifact lacks technical fidelity -> Mitigation: Sales Ops to consult a designated eng liaison during synthesis; accept/reject loop in PM backlog.
Risk: Pilot selection bias -> Mitigation: choose three accounts with varied industry and request types (SaaS, FinServ, HealthTech).
acceptance_criteria: Template finalized and stored in Notion with exportable JSON schema.
Rubric document for de-duplication and priority recommendation is published in Confluence.
Sales Ops trained and signed off on pilot process (email confirmation).
Pilot kickoff with three accounts scheduled and pilot measurement dashboard created (internal Redash link).
